meaning_en: a short absence granted for emotional exhaustion
quote: I'm taking a mental-health break.
example: She took a mental-health break after the launch went badly.
example_cn: 发布搞砸之后她请了个心理健康假。
note: 职场委婉说法，通常指当天请假回家躺着。

meaning_en: to write something down quickly and briefly
quote: I will just jot that down, then.
example: Jot down the client's name before you hang up.
example_cn: 挂电话前先把客户名字记下来。
note: jot 是速记；名词 a jot=一点点（not a jot of）。

meaning_en: patronising; talking down to someone
quote: it might sound a little condescending
quote_cn: 听起来可能有点居高临下。
example: Don't be condescending to junior staff.
example_cn: 别用说教的口吻跟新人说话。
note: 常含冒犯意味。反义 deferential（恭敬的）。

meaning_en: completely ordinary and unremarkable
quote: This is your garden variety generic decongestant.
quote_cn: 这就是最普通不过的通用型鼻塞药。
example: Don't expect garden variety service here.
example_cn: 别指望这儿的服务是普通水平。
note: 字面「花园品种（常见品种）」，引申为最平凡不过的。

meaning_en: someone addicted to methamphetamine
quote: The tweakers use this to make this.
quote_cn: 那些冰鬼用这个来做这个。
example: The documentary follows a former tweaker trying to get clean.
example_cn: 这部纪录片跟拍一个想戒毒的瘾君子。
note: tweak 本义「微调」，俚语里指冰毒。tweaker 也可指一般瘾君子。

meaning_en: a warning sign that something is wrong
quote: That should have been a red flag, okay?
quote_cn: 那本来就该是个危险信号。
example: Missing receipts for three items is a red flag.
example_cn: 三件商品没有小票就是危险信号。
note: 职场面试、审计、投资都用；throw a red flag／raise red flags。

meaning_en: use your head; think
quote: Use your noggin.
example: Use your noggin before you approve the refund.
example_cn: 批退款前先动动脑子。
note: 口语。noggin＝脑袋；同义 get your head around it。

meaning_en: someone who believes they are superior
meaning_cn: 自命不凡的人；精英分子
quote: I'm not an elitist
example: Calling him an elitist ended the discussion.
example_cn: 说他自命不凡，讨论就结束了。
note: 形容词 elitist；也作 a fashion elitist。

meaning_en: to inform headquarters, usually to cause trouble
quote: But then someone reported me to corporate.
quote_cn: 然后有人把我举报到总部了。
example: If you report to corporate, expect an investigation.
example_cn: 你要举报到总部，那就等着被调查吧。
note: corporate 在这里是「公司总部」这个部门，不只是形容词。

meaning_en: to become successful in life
meaning_cn: 闯出点名堂；成就一番事业
quote: I'm here to make something of myself.
quote_cn: 我来这儿是为了闯出点名堂。
example: He moved abroad to make something of himself.
example_cn: 他出国是为了闯出自己的天地。
note: 移民、励志语境高频。反义 make something of nothing（白手起家）。

meaning_en: to start an independent life or career
quote: Spread my wings
example: After the merger he spread his wings and went solo.
example_cn: 并购之后他展翅单干了。
note: 字面鸟展翅；常用于离家独立或另立门户。

meaning_en: to acquire knowledge through doing
quote: You'll learn as you go.
example: Nobody reads the manual; you learn as you go.
example_cn: 没人看手册的，都是边干边学。
note: 非常高频的入门安慰。反义 learn the hard way（吃一堑长一智）。

meaning_en: to avoid offending someone in authority
quote: stay on the floor supervisor's good side
example: It's worth staying on the finance team's good side.
example_cn: 还是跟财务部搞好关系值得。
note: get on someone's good side＝讨好。职场潜规则说法。

meaning_en: point-of-sale system; the checkout and inventory software
quote: our POS system is down
example: The POS system crashed, so the line is backed up.
example_cn: 收银系统崩了，队伍排起来了。
note: 零售/餐饮行业标准缩写。重音在 POS。

meaning_en: to cancel a system restriction with special permission
quote: "override, yes," "reduce 0.
example: A supervisor has to override the price to honour the match.
example_cn: 主管得越权改价才能兑现承诺。
note: 零售软件操作术语；形容词 an override＝例外许可。

meaning_en: to postpone a decision overnight
quote: I'm gonna go sleep on it.
example: Never sign on the spot; sleep on it overnight.
example_cn: 别当场签，睡一觉再说。
note: 极实用的职场建议；也可指字面睡着。

meaning_en: to buy a lot of something in advance
quote: This mistake is being corrected, so stock up quick!
quote_cn: 这个错误马上要改，赶紧囤货！
example: Shoppers stocked up before the price hike.
example_cn: 涨价前顾客都囤了货。
note: stock 也作名词「存货」；stock up on something 更地道。

meaning_en: the retail maxim that shoppers are never at fault
quote: the customer is always right
example: Customer service here really believes the customer is always right.
example_cn: 这儿的客服真信奉「顾客永远是对的」。
note: 零售业箴言，常被反讽引用。来源有争议，常归给 Harry Gordon Selfridge。

meaning_en: to make a mistake; to ruin something
quote: the less screwing everything up you do, the better
quote_cn: 你少把事情搞砸点就好。
example: Don't screw up the merge while I'm on holiday.
example_cn: 我休假期间别把合并搞砸了。
note: 粗俗但极常用。screw up your life、screw you 都常见。

meaning_en: to amaze or overwhelm someone
quote: That really blew my mind.
example: The budget for that project blew my mind.
example_cn: 那个项目的预算吓到我了。
note: mind-blowing 是形容词；mind = 理智，不是「心」。

meaning_en: an overly cautious or dull person
quote: I'm the stick in the mud.
example: Call him a stick in the mud if you want, but he never breaks policy.
example_cn: 你可以说他保守，但他从不违规。
note: 近义 wet blanket（扫兴的人）。stick-in-the-mud 作形容词。

meaning_en: the display rack at the end of a store aisle
quote: We need new shelf flags for the end caps
example: End caps are rented out to suppliers for extra income.
example_cn: 端架位置会租给供应商赚外快。
note: 零售术语；shelf flag＝货架价签。

meaning_en: impossible to make out or detect
quote: no discernible scars or tattoos
quote_cn: 没有可辨的伤疤或纹身。
example: There was no discernible difference between the two drafts.
example_cn: 两版草稿看不出差别。
note: 偏法律与正式语体；日常用 obvious / noticeable。

meaning_en: indirectly, taking a roundabout route
quote: just somewhat circuitously
example: He answered circuitously because the truth was incriminating.
example_cn: 他绕着回答，因为实话会害了他。
note: 形容词 circuitous＝迂回的。动词 circuit＝绕行。

meaning_en: to act without being asked
quote: I took the initiative upon myself to reorganize the toy section
quote_cn: 我自作主张把玩具区重新整理了一遍。
example: She took the initiative and fixed the broken vendor list.
example_cn: 她主动把有问题的供应商清单修了。
note: 搭配 take the initiative to do sth / on sth。近义 be proactive。

meaning_en: to make something easier for someone
quote: for the convenience of adult shoppers
example: The meeting was moved for the convenience of the Tokyo office.
example_cn: 为了方便东京办公室，会议改期了。
note: 正式语体；近义 for the sake of。名词 convenience=便利。

meaning_en: retail radio code meaning a customer needs help
meaning_cn: 「绿码」——顾客需要协助（零售暗号）
quote: I'm calling to report a code green in progress.
example: Code green, aisle six, spilled product on the floor.
example_cn: 绿码，六号通道，地上有商品洒了。
note: 零售/仓储业内部暗号，顾客听不到。类似 code blue、code 33。

meaning_en: to mention something casually and briefly
quote: so I'm just throwing that out there
example: I'm only throwing that out there; no pressure.
example_cn: 我就是随口提一句，没有压力。
note: 语气词，暗示这只是个建议，不要当结论。
